sentences.en: Did you break the window on purpose or by accident?
sentences.zh: 你故意打破窗户了吗？还是不小心弄破的？

sentences.en: If your windows are not airtight, moisture will seep in.
sentences.zh: 如果窗户不密封，湿气会渗进来。

sentences.en: It looks like rain. We had better shut the windows.
sentences.zh: 看天色好像要下雨了。我们最好把窗户关上。

senses.zh: 窗户，窗口；窗格，窗玻璃；（计算机屏幕上的）窗口；机会，时机；期限，时限
